description_text:
Carapace: A little more than twice as long as high, with mid-dorsal groove bifurcating posteriorly; surface covered with numerous small spines.
Pseudorostrum: Two-ninths of total carapace length, prominent and sharply pointed; lower part serrated.
Eyelobe: Obsolete.
Antenna I: First two segments studded with blunt spines; first segment nearly twice as long as second and more than twice as long as third.
Maxilliped 2: Ischiobasis fairly long; terminal seta long and slender; carpus with five spines; propodus with tooth; dactyl with three spines.
Maxilliped 3: Basis long, serrated; merus and carpus serrated.
Pereopod 1: Basis long, serrated.
Pereopod 2: Basis about half as long as rest; dactyl slender, tapered, with three spines.
Uropod: Peduncle serrated, more than twice as long as endopod; endopod longer than exopod, with spines.
Type locality: 0°46'S, 29°28'W–0°46.5'S, 29°24'W, 3459 m.
